uncited: Each face lists 4 STD corner indices in face-local counter-clockwise (CCW) order (viewed from outside) and 4 edge indices.
*   **Time Complexity:** The Gather pass is $O(F)$ where $F$ is the number of faces, as each face is rasterized once.
The Resolve pass is $O(P \cdot D)$ where $P$ is the number of pixels and $D$ is the average depth (number of fragments per pixel).
Data textures scale with mesh size but are bounded by the `TEX_WIDTH = 4096` constraint.
Works within WebGL2 constraints by avoiding SSBOs.
Fixed fragment buffer size may limit very deep scenes.
